User.title: User
User.description: Represents an individual user within the Datatrixs application, linked to their external authentication identity and application-specific roles. This entity focuses on application profile and authorization data, not authentication credentials.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

externalAuthIdentifier.description: Unique identifier provided by the external authentication system (e.g., Google, email/password provider's user ID). This links the Datatrixs user profile to their authenticated identity.

email.description: The user's email address, used for contact and display within the app. It is assumed to be verified by the external authentication system.

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

role.description: The application-specific role assigned to the user (e.g., 'Admin', 'Analyst', 'LocationManager'). This determines authorization and capabilities within Datatrixs.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created in Datatrixs.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was last updated in Datatrixs.

Company.title: Company
Company.description: Represents a private equity holding company, acting as the umbrella organization for multiple retail locations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Company entity.

name.description: The official name of the holding company.

description.description: A brief description of the holding company.

userIds.description: References to Users who have access to or manage this company. (Relationship: User N:N Company)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the company record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the company record was last updated.

Location.title: Location
Location.description: Represents an individual retail tire shop location managed by a holding company.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Location entity.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company that owns this location. (Relationship: Company 1:N Location)

name.description: The name of the retail location.

addressLine1.description: The primary street address of the location.

addressLine2.description: Secondary address information for the location (e.g., suite number).

city.description: The city where the location is situated.

state.description: The state or province where the location is situated.

zipCode.description: The postal code of the location.

phoneNumber.description: The main contact phone number for the location.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the location record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the location record was last updated.

ChartOfAccounts.title: ChartOfAccounts
ChartOfAccounts.description: Defines a standardized set of financial accounts that can be used by a company or a group of locations for consistent financial reporting.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ChartOfAccounts entity.

name.description: The name of the Chart of Accounts (e.g., 'Datatrixs Standard COA', 'Company A Custom COA').

description.description: A description of this Chart of Accounts.

companyId.description: Reference to the Company if this Chart of Accounts is custom for a specific holding company. (Relationship: Company 0..1:N ChartOfAccounts)

isStandard.description: Indicates if this is a globally standardized Chart of Accounts or a custom one for a specific company.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the Chart of Accounts was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the Chart of Accounts was last updated.

Account.title: Account
Account.description: Represents an individual financial account within a specific Chart of Accounts (e.g., 'Cash', 'Sales Revenue').

id.description: Unique identifier for the Account entity.

chartOfAccountsId.description: Reference to the ChartOfAccounts this account belongs to. (Relationship: ChartOfAccounts 1:N Account)

accountNumber.description: The unique numerical identifier for the account within its Chart of Accounts (e.g., '1000', '4000').

name.description: The human-readable name of the account (e.g., 'Cash', 'Accounts Receivable').

category.description: The primary financial category of the account (e.g., 'Asset', 'Liability', 'Equity', 'Revenue', 'Expense').

subCategory.description: An optional, more specific sub-category for the account (e.g., 'Current Asset', 'Operating Revenue').

description.description: A detailed description of the account's purpose or usage.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the account record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the account record was last updated.

FinancialDataSource.title: FinancialDataSource
FinancialDataSource.description: Represents a connection to an external financial system (e.g., QuickBooks) or a record of a specific uploaded file (e.g., Excel/CSV) for a location.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FinancialDataSource entity.

locationId.description: Reference to the Location this financial data source is linked to. (Relationship: Location 1:N FinancialDataSource)

sourceType.description: The type of the financial data source (e.g., 'QuickBooks', 'ExcelUpload', 'CSVUpload').

name.description: A user-friendly name for this data source (e.g., 'QuickBooks Sync for Main Street', 'Q3 2023 Revenue Spreadsheet').

connectionDetailsJson.description: A JSON string containing configuration details specific to the source type (e.g., QuickBooks RealmId, file path/name for uploads, mapping configurations).

status.description: The current status of the data source (e.g., 'Active', 'Inactive', 'Processing', 'Error').

lastIngestedAt.description: Timestamp of the last successful data ingestion or synchronization from this source.

createdByUserId.description: Reference to the User who set up this data source or performed the manual upload. (Relationship: User 1:N FinancialDataSource)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the data source record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the data source record was last updated.

FinancialTransaction.title: FinancialTransaction
FinancialTransaction.description: Represents a single consolidated financial transaction, which can consist of multiple financial entries.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FinancialTransaction entity.

locationId.description: Reference to the Location where this transaction occurred. (Relationship: Location 1:N FinancialTransaction)

financialDataSourceId.description: Reference to the FinancialDataSource from which this transaction originated. (Relationship: FinancialDataSource 1:N FinancialTransaction)

transactionDate.description: The date when the financial transaction occurred.

description.description: A descriptive summary of the financial transaction.

originalTransactionId.description: The original identifier of the transaction from the external accounting system (e.g., QuickBooks transaction ID), if available.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this financial transaction was first recorded in Datatrixs.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this financial transaction record was last updated.

FinancialEntry.title: FinancialEntry
FinancialEntry.description: Represents a single debit or credit entry associated with a FinancialTransaction, linked to a specific Account.

id.description: Unique identifier for the FinancialEntry entity.

financialTransactionId.description: Reference to the FinancialTransaction this entry belongs to. (Relationship: FinancialTransaction 1:N FinancialEntry)

accountId.description: Reference to the Account impacted by this entry. (Relationship: Account 1:N FinancialEntry)

amount.description: The monetary value of the entry.

entryType.description: Indicates whether the entry is a 'Debit' or a 'Credit'.

memo.description: An optional, specific memo or note for this individual financial entry.

ReportConfiguration.title: ReportConfiguration
ReportConfiguration.description: Stores user-defined settings and parameters for custom financial reports, charts, or spreadsheet exports generated within the application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ReportConfiguration entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who created or owns this report configuration. (Relationship: User 1:N ReportConfiguration)

name.description: A user-defined name for the saved report configuration.

description.description: A brief description explaining the purpose or scope of the report.

reportType.description: The type of report or output this configuration generates (e.g., 'IncomeStatement', 'BalanceSheet', 'CustomChart', 'SpreadsheetExport').

companyId.description: Optional reference to a specific Company if the report is scoped to a particular holding company. (Relationship: Company 0..1:N ReportConfiguration)

locationIds.description: Optional references to specific Locations if the report's scope is limited to a subset of locations. (Relationship: Location N:N ReportConfiguration)

configurationDetailsJson.description: A JSON string containing all specific parameters for the report, such as date ranges, filters, chart types, selected accounts, etc.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the report configuration was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the report configuration was last updated.

definition.description: Stores individual user profiles. The document ID (`userId`) must match the user's external authentication ID (Firebase Authentication `uid`). Used for personal profile data. Includes the user's `role` for general application roles, though critical global roles are managed separately.

A collection used for defining global application administrators. A document exists here (where `adminId` is a `userId`) if the user is an application administrator. This follows the 'existence over content' model for simple, robust global role checks in security rules.

params.name: adminId
params.description: The unique identifier of a user who is an application administrator. This ID corresponds to the user's `externalAuthIdentifier` or `request.auth.uid`.

definition.description: Stores holding company information. The `userIds` array from the schema will be transformed into a `members` map (e.g., `{ [uid: string]: 'role' }` or `{ [uid: string]: true }`) for direct access control checks. This `members` map, along with the `companyId`, will be denormalized into all child/related documents requiring company-level authorization.

params.name: companyId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific holding company.

definition.description: Stores individual retail location information. Includes denormalized 'companyId' and 'companyMembers' map (from the parent company) for authorization independence.

params.name: locationId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific retail location.

definition.description: Stores globally available, standardized Charts of Accounts. These are generally publicly readable but only writable by administrators. The `isStandard` field will be `true`.

params.name: chartOfAccountsId
params.description: The unique identifier for a standard Chart of Accounts.

definition.description: Stores Chart of Accounts specific to a holding company. Includes denormalized 'companyId' and 'companyMembers' map (from the parent company) for authorization independence. The `isStandard` field will be `false`.

params.name: companyId
params.description: The unique identifier for the parent holding company.

params.name: chartOfAccountsId
params.description: The unique identifier for a company-specific Chart of Accounts.

definition.description: Individual financial accounts belonging to a standard Chart of Accounts. These inherit the globally readable security posture of their parent COA.

params.name: chartOfAccountsId
params.description: The unique identifier for the parent standard Chart of Accounts.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific financial account.

definition.description: Individual financial accounts belonging to a company-specific Chart of Accounts. Includes denormalized 'companyId' and 'companyMembers' map (from the grandparent company) for authorization independence.

params.name: companyId
params.description: The unique identifier for the grandparent holding company.

params.name: chartOfAccountsId
params.description: The unique identifier for the parent company-specific Chart of Accounts.

params.name: accountId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific financial account.

definition.description: Connections to external financial systems or records of uploaded files. Includes denormalized 'locationId', 'companyId', and 'companyMembers' map (from the company owning the location) for authorization independence.

params.name: financialDataSourceId
params.description: The unique identifier for a financial data source.

definition.description: Consolidated financial transactions. Includes denormalized 'locationId', 'companyId', and 'companyMembers' map (from the company owning the location) for authorization independence.

params.name: financialTransactionId
params.description: The unique identifier for a financial transaction.

definition.description: Individual debit/credit entries within a financial transaction. Includes denormalized 'locationId', 'companyId', and 'companyMembers' map (from the company owning the location) for authorization independence.

params.name: financialTransactionId
params.description: The unique identifier for the parent financial transaction.

params.name: financialEntryId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific financial entry.

definition.description: User-specific saved report configurations. This path ensures ownership by `userId`. If a `companyId` is specified within the report configuration, the `companyId` and `companyMembers` map from that company will be denormalized into the document for authorization independence. References to `locationIds` are for data filtering, with actual data access determined by the denormalized authorization fields on the respective data entities.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user who owns this report configuration.

params.name: reportConfigurationId
params.description: The unique identifier for a specific report configuration.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure for Datatrixs prioritizes secure, scalable, and debuggable authorization by strictly adhering to the core design principles and strategy mandates. The central theme is **Authorization Independence via Denormalization** and **Structural Segregation** to simplify security rules and enable Queryable Access Patterns (QAPs).

**Authorization Independence:** To prevent costly and complex `get()` calls in Firestore Security Rules, the authorization context (specifically, membership of a holding company) is denormalized across related documents. The `Company` entity includes a `members` map (derived from the `userIds` array in the schema), which stores the `uid` of each authorized user. This `companyId` and the `members` map are then copied down to all dependent entities such as `Location`, `FinancialDataSource`, `FinancialTransaction`, `FinancialEntry`, and company-specific `ChartOfAccounts` and `Account` documents. For `ReportConfiguration` documents, if they are scoped to a `companyId`, that company's `companyId` and `members` map are also denormalized into the report configuration document itself. This ensures that any document can determine its authorization directly from its own fields, without needing to traverse parent documents.

**Queryable Access Patterns (QAPs):**
*   **User Profiles:** `users/{userId}` allows direct access for a user to their own profile (`request.auth.uid == userId`). Admins can list all users.
*   **Global Roles:** `/app_roles_admin/{adminId}` provides an 'existence over content' model for global administrators, enabling efficient checks for elevated privileges without filtering.
*   **Company and Location-Scoped Data:** For `Company` and all its dependent entities (`Location`, `FinancialDataSource`, `FinancialTransaction`, `FinancialEntry`, and company-specific `ChartOfAccounts`/`Account`s), the denormalized `companyMembers` map enables secure `list` operations. Users can query for documents where `resource.data.companyMembers[request.auth.uid]` is true. This ensures that list results are intrinsically filtered by security rules, fulfilling the QAP requirement without exposing unauthorized data.
*   **Standard Chart of Accounts:** `/standard_charts_of_accounts` and its subcollection `/accounts` are globally readable, allowing straightforward listing for all users.
*   **User-Owned Data:** `users/{userId}/report_configurations/{reportConfigurationId}` enforces path-based ownership (`request.auth.uid == userId`) for personal report configurations, and further checks the denormalized `companyMembers` if the report is company-scoped.

**Structural Segregation:** The `ChartOfAccounts` entity is split into two distinct collections: `/standard_charts_of_accounts` for globally accessible accounts and `/companies/{companyId}/charts_of_accounts` for company-specific, restricted accounts. This separation ensures each collection has a homogeneous security posture, simplifying rule definitions. The same segregation applies to their respective `Account` subcollections.

This design leverages denormalization extensively, standardizes authorization fields, and structurally segregates data based on access needs, resulting in a Firestore structure that is inherently secure, performant for queries, and easy to manage with concise security rules.
